subject.title: Feature Request: Add MathJax/LaTeX Support to Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor first-party Control UI math rendering in core, and if so should the accepted path be a default-off KaTeX/MathJax config surface with sanitizer and dependency review?
rationale: The request has clear user demand and fits web frontend ergonomics, but it adds a core UI dependency, public configuration, and untrusted-rendering security surface that automation should not accept by default.

options.title: Sponsor one core implementation
options.body: Review one open KaTeX/MathJax PR to completion with dependency approval, sanitizer review, parser compatibility fixes, and real Control UI proof, then close this issue after merge.

options.title: Defer out of core
options.body: Keep core markdown unchanged and ask for a plugin/API design only if current extension points cannot provide the behavior safely.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Decline first-party math rendering for now and close the related candidate PRs and duplicate issues with the product rationale.

recommendation.title: Sponsor one core implementation
recommendation.body: Review one open KaTeX/MathJax PR to completion with dependency approval, sanitizer review, parser compatibility fixes, and real Control UI proof, then close this issue after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is connected to the original Control UI markdown rendering path and adjacent product/config decisions for this surface.
